name: Physical
description: Sheila Rubin is a quietly tormented housewife in ’80s San Diego. Behind closed doors, she battles extreme personal demons and a vicious inner voice. But things change when she discovers aerobics, sparking a journey toward empowerment and success.

videos.title: Let's Do This Thing
videos.overview: Sheila discovers aerobics as a new outlet for her body anxiety. Danny, her husband, pursues a calling in politics after bad news about his job.

videos.title: Let's Get Political
videos.overview: Desperate for more aerobics, Sheila struggles to get back to Bunny's studio while also helping Danny lock down a much-needed endorsement.

videos.title: Let's Get Down to Business
videos.overview: Debt mounting, Sheila decides to teach a class—but is tasked with recruiting new students. Danny hunts for enough signatures to get on the ballot.

videos.title: Let's Get This Party Started
videos.overview: Danny hires a campaign manager from their past who causes friction with Sheila. Greta opens up about a nagging suspicion in her marriage.

videos.title: Let's Agree to Disagree
videos.overview: Sheila teams up with Tyler to show her newfound vision—and unearths a disturbing secret. Danny participates in a debate and Bunny has a visitor.

videos.title: Let's Get It on Tape
videos.overview: Sheila films two videos—one for aerobics and one for Danny's campaign—plunging herself deeper into debt and deception.

videos.title: Let's Take This Show on the Road
videos.overview: The Rubins head to Los Angeles, where they visit the Logans in hopes of fundraising at a party. Breem's demons surface.

videos.title: Let's Not and Say We Did
videos.overview: In need of money, Sheila pays an unexpected visit to her parents—and her past. Greta finally confronts Ernie.

videos.title: Let's Face the Facts
videos.overview: Sheila is determined to put aerobics behind her but finds the pull too strong. Tyler contends with an unexpected health condition.

videos.title: Let's Get Together
videos.overview: With election day looming, Sheila entertains an intriguing proposition. Bunny's finances and Tyler's health come to a head.

videos.title: Don't You Want Me
videos.overview: Sheila has replaced her former vice with a new one, while her frustration with Danny builds.

videos.title: Don't You Ever Stop
videos.overview: Sheila is confronted as she performs an aerobics demonstration. Danny leads a group of young environmental activists.

videos.title: Don't You Go Far
videos.overview: Pushing through haunting memories and physical pain, Sheila seeks relief in the class of a local fitness icon. Bunny visits someone from her past.

videos.title: Don't You Know
videos.overview: Sheila solicits Bunny to fill in for her at promotional events. Greta and Ernie spice up their marriage.

videos.title: Don't You Want to Watch
videos.overview: Tyler and Bunny concoct a scheme. John confides in someone who was close to his father. Sheila and Greta get advice from Vinnie Green.

videos.title: Don't You Have Enough
videos.overview: Danny makes some discoveries. Sheila and John discuss how to handle the threat. Greta proposes a new experience to the Rubins.

videos.title: Don't Try This at Home
videos.overview: With Danny and Greta pledging their support, Sheila makes a decision no one expects.

videos.title: Don't You Run and Hide
videos.overview: Sheila gets a look inside Vinnie Green’s operation. Danny does some soul-searching.

videos.title: Don't You Want to Get Better
videos.overview: In seclusion, Sheila searches for the courage and strength to face her demons.

videos.title: Don't You Say It's Over
videos.overview: With Sheila and Greta embarking on a new endeavor, Danny wants what he thinks he deserves.

videos.title: Like a Whole New Woman
videos.overview: Sheila and Greta enlist an unlikely ally to protect Body by Sheila's financial freedom. A new menace supplants Sheila's inner voice.

videos.title: Like a Bitch
videos.overview: Sheila's search for her public persona triggers repressed trauma. Breem hunts down a vandal. Danny discovers a new passion.

videos.title: Like It's on Fire
videos.overview: New romance helps Sheila connect with her deeper self. Greta pursues a lucrative deal. Breem vies to impress the committee.

videos.title: Like a Rocket
videos.overview: A fitness expo challenges Sheila's recovery when it brings her face to face with Kelly.

videos.title: Like Crazy
videos.overview: A reeling Sheila risks her most important business partnership. Danny reaches out for help. Breem struggles to support his wife.

videos.title: Like You Mean It
videos.overview: Sheila can't escape her imagined enemy. Danny goes on a dangerous date.

videos.title: Like No One's Watching
videos.overview: Bitter competition pushes Sheila and Greta to the edge. Breem learns about his family. Intrusive thoughts force Sheila to question her relationship.

videos.title: Like a Mouse
videos.overview: Sheila and Greta envision a bold new future. Danny goes on a joyride. Maya acts up in front of Carlos.

videos.title: Like We Never Left
videos.overview: Maya forces Sheila and Danny to work together.

videos.title: Like a Prayer
videos.overview: Sheila uses aerobics to foster connection and healing.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 5 nominations total
